description: Initialize NestJS app with proper config, validation, healthchecks, structured logger (Task 4.1), RLS middleware (Task 4.2), and Prisma schema with User model (Task 4.3). Also set up mock-KMS placeholder (Task 2.2) and seed script (Task 2.3).
steps: Add NestJS core dependencies to apps/api/package.json: @nestjs/core, @nestjs/common, @nestjs/platform-express, @nestjs/config, reflect-metadata, rxjs, nestjs-pino, pino, pino-http, pino-pretty (devDep), zod, @prisma/client. DevDeps: prisma, @types/express, vitest, @nestjs/testing
Rewrite apps/api/src/main.ts as proper NestJS bootstrap: create NestFactory.create(AppModule), configure pino logger, set global prefix 'api', graceful shutdown hooks, listen on port from config
Create apps/api/src/app.module.ts as root module importing ConfigModule (with Zod env validation schema), HealthModule, PrismaModule, AuthModule (placeholder empty)
Create apps/api/src/config/env.schema.ts with Zod schema validating DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, API_PORT, NODE_ENV, JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRY, etc.
Create apps/api/src/health/health.module.ts and health.controller.ts with GET /healthz (liveness) and GET /readyz (readiness check for Postgres and Redis ping)
Create apps/api/src/common/filters/problem-details.filter.ts implementing ExceptionFilter to return RFC 7807 ProblemDetails JSON responses
Create apps/api/src/common/pipes/zod-validation.pipe.ts implementing PipeTransform for Zod schema validation
Create apps/api/src/prisma/prisma.module.ts and prisma.service.ts wrapping PrismaClient with onModuleInit/onModuleDestroy lifecycle hooks

Create apps/api/src/common/middleware/rls.middleware.ts that reads userId from request (will come from JWT guard later) and executes SET LOCAL app.user_id = $userId on the Prisma connection via $executeRawUnsafe

Create apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma with datasource, generator, extensions (pgcrypto, citext, pg_trgm, vector), User model (id UUID, email CITEXT unique, passwordHash nullable, ssoProvider nullable, role enum listener/enthusiast/power_user/admin, mfaEnabled, mfaSecret, displayName, avatarUrl, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt nullable), PrivacySetting model, AuditLog model (append-only: id, userId, action, category, metadata JSON, ipAddress, createdAt)

Add mock-KMS service: create apps/api/src/kms/kms.module.ts and kms.service.ts with interface KmsClient (encrypt, decrypt, generateDataKey) and MockKmsService implementation using Node.js crypto (AES-256-GCM with random keys stored in-memory for dev)

Create apps/api/src/seed.ts script that: connects to Prisma, creates admin user (admin@openmusic.dev) and listener user (listener@openmusic.dev) with hashed passwords, creates sample FeatureFlag records. Add 'db:seed:dev' script to apps/api/package.json
Update apps/api/tsconfig.json to ensure paths work with new structure (keep experimentalDecorators, emitDecoratorMetadata)
Run pnpm install, then pnpm run typecheck and pnpm run lint to verify everything compiles
acceptance_criteria: apps/api/src/main.ts is a proper NestJS bootstrap with graceful shutdown
apps/api/src/app.module.ts imports ConfigModule with Zod env validation
ProblemDetails exception filter returns RFC 7807 compliant error responses
Prisma schema has User, PrivacySetting, AuditLog models with proper types
RLS middleware exists and sets app.user_id from request
Seed script exists and can be run with 'pnpm db:seed:dev'
pnpm run typecheck passes for the api package
